arithmetic.letterbox: scale=min(target_w/source_w,target_h/source_h); content_w=min(target_w,max(1,floor(source_w*scale+0.5))); content_h analogously; left=(target_w-content_w)//2, top=(target_h-content_h)//2; remainder right/bottom; pad after resize; normalize last
arithmetic.edge_policy: Preserve antialiased scene/UI boundaries; exact float32 ImageNet-mean fill before normalization; never rounded uint8 colors

augmentation.application: Draw one independent brightness/contrast pair per original image in [0.9,1.1]; apply brightness then contrast to valid scene pixels in shared raw float32 tensor, excluding static UI from statistics; fill UI afterward with exact mean; all five views inherit the same pair

photometric_formulas.scope: Valid scene pixels after footer crop, before UI mean fill; UI excluded from statistics
photometric_formulas.contrast: gray_mean = mean(sum(brightness_adjusted_scene * grayscale_weights, channel), valid_pixels); clamp(c*image+(1-c)*gray_mean,0,1)
photometric_formulas.fill: Fill UI with exact ImageNet float32 mean after photometric changes; preserve padding

preprocessing.global_source: Construct global directly from the same processed raw float tensor as all four local crops
preprocessing.local_source: Extract each config-ordered rectangle directly from the same processed raw float32 tensor; square tensor bilinear antialiased resize to 320x320; normalize after construction
